answer: At dawn, every agent that wants to join the shared marketplace must lock a small refundable bond and complete a proof-of-useful-work task that cannot be copied across identities. If two identities wander through the same task with identical behavior, the system flags the shared thread of activity, same timing, same inputs, same outputs, and slashes the bond. Honest agents keep their stake and reputation, while a sybil farm would need a fresh bond and fresh work for every fake identity, making mass fakery expensive and easy to spot.
